title: I recommend this bike ride
text: Very nice ride to discover the city with a little less fatigue than on foot or looking for/waiting for means of transport. With a French guide who was also one, knowing the places and the history well.
author: Lucienne_T

title: Perfect way to explore the city
text: I was choosing between a walking tour and a bike tour, and I’m really happy I picked the bike tour. It s just a much better way to see Barcelona, you cover more places, but it still feels relaxed. The Dutch bikes were comfortable and easy to ride. Our guide was very friendly and attentive, and because the group was small, he even showed us a few extra spots along the way. I really enjoyed it!!!
author: crisaA1188JQ

title: lovely experience
text: I had a great time on this bike tour. The route was great, and I learned a lot of new and interesting things about Barcelona. The guide had a very engaging and artistic way of telling the stories, which made the experience feel lively and enjoyable. It was a nice balance of learning about the city while simply having a good time exploring it by bike. Thank you 💜
author: infernalbunny

title: Amazing
text: Amazing bike tour through Barcelona! It was really cool to see and hear the history of the city from a completely different perspective. The guide showed not only the famous places, but also shared many interesting stories and details that you normally wouldn’t notice. Highly recommended!
author: Dreamer761808

title: Absolutely amazing ☺️
text: The bike tour around Barcelona was absolutely amazing! The route was beautiful and very well planned, and our guide was friendly, knowledgeable, and made the whole experience really enjoyable. I loved being able to explore the city by bike and admire the beauty of Barcelona from a different perspective. The entire excursion was fun, interesting, and unforgettable. I highly recommend this tour to everyone visiting Barcelona!
author: B2370IPpetrs

title: Very good experience and excellent service.
text: I was very satisfied with the experience. The service was quick, professional, and everything was very well organized. The staff was friendly and attentive at all times. Without a doubt, I would return and recommend it to others.
author: alekseis81
